channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Klay Thompson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Klay Thompson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Andrew Wiggins on Klay Thompson
item.description:
Andrew Wiggins on reuniting with Klay Thompson:

“He’s one of the most competitive people I played with. To have him on the squad is going to be amazing. — He’s one of one. He brings that championship mentality to the team and this is a year that we can do something special and he’s someone that can be a big part of it”

Andrew Wiggins on Klay Thompson, Sep 3, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Klay Thompson
item.description:
“But I study the history, I do the research, and I'm going to appreciate and watch and know the Klay Thompson of 2017, '18, '19, he was capable.”

Draymond Green on Klay Thompson, Aug 27, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Pat Riley on Klay Thompson
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Pat Riley on Klay Thompson:

“Klay is one of the most iconic players to ever suit up in the NBA.A four-time battle tested World Champion who will fit perfectly into his role as an all-around player at both ends of the court. We all talk about his shooting skill, but there is so much more he brings to the game. We are blessed that Klay chose the Heat in our quest to challenge for championships.”

Pat Riley on Klay Thompson, Aug 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Klay Thompson, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
“Joel, mvp recently. Jaylen brown, recent finals mvp, Tyrese Maxey, all star the last 3 years. We all know what bron does. Klay Thompson, never a mvp candidate in nothing, 22ppg. Draymond, 14ppg 7 rebounds 6 assist, Steph a mvp just like Joel was. I don’t get how the warriors team is better on paper.”

Kevin Durant on Klay Thompson, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Aug 4, 2026. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant, Andrew Bogut, Klay Thompson
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Who are your top three defensive teammates of all time? Andrew Bogut number one, Klay Thompson number two. Klay Thompson, ball hawk. And I'd say number three, number three, my favorite defensive teammate of all time, or not favorite, but top three. Kevin Durant was elite defensively here. Elite. Andre Iguodala. Andre Iguodala made the game really easy. Got to go with Andre. It has to be Andre.”

Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant, Andrew Bogut, Klay Thompson, Jun 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Andre Iguodala, Paul George, Klay Thompson, Draymond Green
item.description:
Beverley revealed he thinks Golden State would have won more than four titles if Paul George replaced Thompson.

“If you put Paul George in that role playing as Klay Thompson, playing with [Steph Curry, Draymond Green, Andre Iguodala] at a point -- obviously we know Paul George a couple years ago, was in the MVP race,”

Patrick Beverley on Andre Iguodala, Paul George, Klay Thompson, Draymond Green, Aug 25, 2025. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Klay Thompson
item.description:
Kyrie Irving on Klay Thompson’s claim that this is just another November game:

“Yeah, sounds about right when we’re all trying to downplay kind of just what we’re going into, especially playing against one of our former teams. But as competitors, we all feel it. It’s emotions that are heightened, but it’s basketball at the end of the day.”

Kyrie Irving on Klay Thompson, Nov 12, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Klay Thompson
item.description:
“If he’s open, he’s going to knock it down. It’s Klay Thompson, one of the greatest shooters ever.”

Luka Doncic on Klay Thompson, Oct 23, 2024. Source: Dallas Hoops Journal.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Klay Thompson
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Kyrie Irving on Klay Thompson’s impact with the Mavs:

“I feel like our dreams can be possible because he’s here now.”

Kyrie Irving on Klay Thompson, Sep 30, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brandin Podziemski on Klay Thompson
item.description:
Brandin Podziemski on Klay Thompson:

“Getting a call from him a couple of days ago, and him telling me I'll always have a brother in him for life is pretty cool. We can't wait to go against him and compete against him when we play Dallas.”

Brandin Podziemski on Klay Thompson, Jul 20, 2024. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Jonathan Kuminga on Klay Thompson
item.description:
“I was a little shocked. Klay Thompson is somebody that took me under his wing when I first got drafted,”

Jonathan Kuminga on Klay Thompson, Jul 14, 2024. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Mike Dunleavy on Klay Thompson
item.description:
Speaking with reporters here in Vegas, Warriors GM Mike Dunleavy says

“I can’t reiterate what an unbelievable run (Klay Thompson) had. We’ll miss him. But life goes on and I think he’s in a good spot.”

Mike Dunleavy on Klay Thompson, Jul 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @kendra__andrews.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Klay Thompson
item.description:
“Klay Thompson gave me a really good description of his frame of mind. I completely understand,”

Steve Kerr on Klay Thompson, Jul 7, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Kyshawn George on Klay Thompson, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
item.description:
Kyshawn George:

“It’s tough for me because there’s a part of me that I always played point guard for 16 years, and now I’m developing to be a wing or shooting guard. I would want to say Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, but I don’t play directly like him. I would want to say Klay Thompson right now because I’m a shooting guard and behind the three-point line a lot, but I think I have more ball-handling creativity than him, so I can’t really tell you. I think I’m a mix of a bunch of players.”

Kyshawn George on Klay Thompson, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Draymond Green on Klay Thompson
item.description:
Ben Golliver:Warriors' Draymond Green on Klay Thompson's future:

“I have no reason to think that our ownership group aren’t going to take care of us. … There’s a lot of organizations that will only do what’s best for the organization. This isn’t one of them.”

Draymond Green on Klay Thompson, Apr 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Draymond Green on Klay Thompson
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Draymond Green on his belief the organization will prioritize Klay Thompson:

“They did right by me. They’ve done right by Steph. They’ve done right by all of us. Klay tore his ACL and they gave him $160 million dollars.”

Draymond Green on Klay Thompson, Apr 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Klay Thompson
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Steve Kerr on Klay Thompson:

“I love Klay so much. What he’s meant to me in the 10 years we’ve been together. I’ve watched him the last couple of years, fighting the feeling of devastation from the injuries. I’ve watched him this year flip his season around with his approach.”

Steve Kerr on Klay Thompson, Apr 17, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Klay Thompson
item.description:
“This is maybe the hardest part about getting further away from our prime. It's just, after 12 years [of Thompson starting], it wasn't easy”

Steve Kerr on Klay Thompson, Feb 29, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Duncan Robinson on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Kyle Korver, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson
item.description:
“I grew up watching a lot of Ray Allen, JJ Redick, and Kyle Korver. Obviously, Steph [Curry] and Klay [Thompson] have kind of revolutionized the 3-point shot as well,”

Duncan Robinson on Ray Allen, JJ Redick, Kyle Korver, Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, Jan 3, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Jaden McDaniels on Klay Thompson
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Jaden McDaniels on Klay Thompson:

“He missed a shot, ran down the court, we probably said something back to each other. To me, it wasn’t that serious. I was laughing and joking around. Some people take things differently.”

Jaden McDaniels on Klay Thompson, Nov 15, 2023. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Klay Thompson
item.description:
“It was Klay (Thompson) at first, now it’s Wiggs.“Whatever the narrative is, we don’t talk about that much in the locker room. Everybody is going to have a high value for us at multiple points throughout the year. So staying committed to that is all any of us can give. … We’re not going to win anything without our guys playing well.”

Stephen Curry on Klay Thompson, Nov 2, 2023. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson
item.description:
“He's like, 'Man, you've got to see Steph [Curry], KD and Klay [Thompson] work out,”

Anthony Edwards on Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, Sep 29, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Klay Thompson, Draymond Green
item.description:
Steph Curry on the trio of him, Klay Thompson and Draymond Green:

“The trust that we're all going to compete until the wheels fall off. That's something that should not be taken for granted in this league.”

Stephen Curry on Klay Thompson, Draymond Green, May 13, 2023. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Draymond Green on Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson
item.description:
“They trust in me and believe in me, just like I trust and believe in them that when our backs are against the wall, we’re gonna put our backs up against the wall, and we’re gonna fight our way up.“I know one person, two people that has the most confidence in me, and that’s Steph Curry and Klay Thompson.”

Draymond Green on Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, May 6, 2023. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Donte DiVincenzo on Klay Thompson
item.description:
“What he's doing is not out of the ordinary. He's been having a hell of a career. Klay Thompson is still Klay Thompson at the end of the day. That rim is this big at all times. And I love that.”

Donte DiVincenzo on Klay Thompson, Feb 27, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Dillon Brooks on Klay Thompson
item.description:
Dillon Brooks on the Klay Thompson taunt:

“Refs let it happen. He was doing it all game then they want to catch the bad guy. That’s wack to me. F-cking up calls and putting the wrong guys at the free-throw line. It was a circus. Should have had different refs.”

Dillon Brooks on Klay Thompson, Dec 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Klay Thompson
item.description:
Still, it seems that Charles arkley has reaffirmed his stance about Thompson in a recent interview with Taylor Rooks of Bleacher Report.

“I was caught off guard because I went back and looked and I said,‘Klay Thompson is still a heck of a player, but he’s never going to be the best two-guard in the NBA that he was for a long time because of age, Achilles and ACL,'”

Charles Barkley on Klay Thompson, Nov 30, 2022. Source: ahnfiredigital.com.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Klay Thompson
item.description:
“It’s a tough balance of trusting him to do exactly what he is capable of doing, you know, being himself. Klay Thompson’s shots have always been ones that you wouldn’t tell anybody else to really take because of his skill set and the work that he puts in. He’s had slow starts before this season but the biggest thing [is] … ‘You got to let the game come to you,'”

Stephen Curry on Klay Thompson, Nov 17, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Klay Thompson
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Klay Thompson's readiness for opener:

“We're 13 days away. My guess is he will be ready. But it's not something we can say yes or no on.”

Steve Kerr on Klay Thompson, Oct 5, 2022. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson
item.description:
“That's the truth. And this one, I don't know how they could be mad because we're homegrown. And I think the luxury tax, you should be paying a high luxury tax if you're using it to go get free agents and outspend your competition. But if you're developing your own guys and paying Steph Curry what he deserves and Klay Thompson what he's earned, why am I paying $200 million in luxury tax? I don't think that's fair.”

Joe Lacob on Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, Jul 19, 2022. Source: Yahoo! Sports.
